findings.title: Recurring calendar deletions are no longer included in the awaited work
findings.body: The async callback passed to `forEach` is not awaited. Each callback now suspends at `await getCalendar(credential)`, while the handler continues to build and eventually awaits `Promise.all(apiDeletes)` at line 652. At that point the callbacks commonly have not yet pushed any delete promises into `apiDeletes`, so a recurring cancellation can complete and delete booking references before its external calendar events are deleted. Rejections from imports or deletions are also detached from the handler. Build an array of promises (or use `Promise.all` over credentials/bookings) and await it before proceeding.

findings.title: Reschedule endpoint fires calendar/video cleanup in an unawaited async forEach
findings.body: Changing this callback to `async` makes every calendar deletion wait for module loading, but `forEach` discards the resulting promises. The mutation sends the reschedule email and returns without waiting for calendar/video cleanup, and failures from `getCalendar` or `deleteEvent` become unhandled promise rejections rather than an endpoint error/logged failure. Replace the `forEach` with `await Promise.all(bookingRefsFiltered.map(...))` (with explicit per-operation error handling as appropriate).

findings.title: Vital reschedule cleanup is detached from the enclosing error handling
findings.body: `forEach(async ...)` does not await its callbacks. Consequently the surrounding `try/catch` only covers scheduling the callbacks; an import failure or `deleteEvent` failure is not caught, and the reschedule flow continues to email/return before cleanup is complete. Since `getCalendar` now always introduces an await point, this is reliably asynchronous rather than merely an unawaited provider deletion. Collect and await the callback promises with `Promise.all`.

findings.title: WipeMyCal reschedule cleanup is detached from the enclosing error handling
findings.body: The new async `forEach` callback is never awaited. Calendar loading and deletion can still be pending when this function sends email and returns, while errors from either operation bypass the surrounding `try/catch` and can become unhandled rejections. Use `await Promise.all(bookingRefsFiltered.map(...))` or an awaited loop so cleanup completion and failures are handled by this flow.
